card.name: Inside split-up proper names and capitalized words
card.fires_on: Responds to a short piece such as CO, il, Ist or din that sits partway through an uppercase trial name, a place name, a person's name, or the word ALCOHOL. The word is unfinished and more letters follow.

modes.label: Trial acronyms
modes.description: The piece CO inside an uppercase trial name such as IZALCO in a list of study names.

modes.label: Capitalized medical word
modes.description: The piece CO inside the all-caps word ALCOHOL in a warning heading.

modes.label: Place and person names
modes.description: A middle piece of a rare place or personal name, such as Eilendorf or Aydin.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of an unusual name or an all-caps word that is not yet finished.
